title: Tesla seeing the future in high-voltage experiments

tellings.quote: was talking about how Tesla um you know, would do some of these high voltage experiments and he would say weird things like I see the future or the present or the past

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla, during some of his high-voltage experiments, would say strange things such as that he could see the future, the present or the past. Michels tells this himself, from a Tesla biographer he does not name, which would suggest strong electric fields can alter the mind.
